item.text: The existing list implementation is a flat text split and currently fails 44 of the 74 list examples, mainly because it loses marker indentation, nested structure, and list tightness. I’m replacing that narrow path with recursive list-item blocks and renderer-side tight/loose handling, while leaving the staged conformance assets unchanged.
